title: Adaptive Low fire
description: Makes your fire lower, while preserving the texture of any chosed texture pack
body:
# Adaptive Low Fire

  Lowers fire to ground level while keeping **your texture pack's fire texture intact**. No texture override - works on
  top of any resource pack.

  ## How It Works

  Fire models sample only the base strip of the fire texture (bottom pixel row). This means whatever fire texture your
  pack uses, Adaptive Low Fire adapts to it automatically — no conflicts, no white fire, no broken look.


  ## Compatibility

  | Minecraft Version | Pack Format | Status |
  |---|---|---|
  | 1.21.x | 75 | Supported |

  > **Note:** This is a Java Edition resource pack. Load it **above** your main texture pack in the resource pack menu
  so it applies correctly.

  ## Installation

  1. Download the `.zip` file
  2. Place it in `.minecraft/resourcepacks/`
  3. Enable it in **Options → Resource Packs**
  4. Load it **above** your base texture pack
